integration_budget.repair_execution: Second slot only for a material versioned repair; failed first result retained.
integration_budget.scope: One generated changed structure with incumbent control seed, actual closed-loop control adaptation, simulation, joint evaluation, comparison and delivery. Not full robustness, research superiority or three-group evidence.

policy.control_policy: Each structure starts incumbent two control weights; one extra bounded coordinate proposal in catalog control order at nominal case/seed17. Advance only on joint acceptance then componentwise dominance; incomparable ties keep earlier proposal.
policy.failure: Preserve failures; unknown reservations not replayed; inadequate adaptation and incomplete runs are not structural infeasibility proofs.
policy.final_selection: Maximize joint accepted count; then componentwise physical dominance; incomparable ties retain earliest candidate and report tradeoff.

mathematical_analysis.reason: No additional local affine analysis is needed to validate this integrated path. Future uses must predeclare decision question and outcomes that change or retain selection.

policy.method: Existing ParameterSpace and bounded coordinate_proposal kernels; discrete scenarios enumerated, never interpolated.
policy.stopping: Bounded allocations, no novel legal proposals, or all remaining proposed work cannot be completely reserved. Budget is ceiling. No success-based pruning of frozen scheduled repetitions.
policy.structure_policy: Start from exact incumbent; numeric coordinate +/- .25 of granted width in catalog order, skip unchanged/duplicates; enumerate remaining discrete options in declared order. Advance centre only on joint acceptance then componentwise dominance. Stop at four structures; unvisited dimensions remain untested.
policy.validation: After adaptation, select up to two nondominated nominal candidates in proposal order; schedule all five cases x two fresh independent repetitions. Adaptation nominal execution does not count as a robustness repetition.

acceptance.authority: tools.research_tasks.assemble_acceptance; unchanged evaluate.reach plus sealed profile/motion.
acceptance.historical_protocol: All historical real-time failures retain original labels; new offline acceptance does not rescore sealed historical results.
acceptance.requirements: Full execution; finite required signals; terminal reach and both holding components and applied force bounds. Missing evidence is unavailable, not physical infeasibility.

boundaries.numerical_settings: Exact incumbent recipe/basis/mesh/backend; solver max_cpu30s/max_iterations120 and feasible-return5/15s unchanged.
boundaries.old_milestones: M4 qualified closed, old M5 open and sealed negative successor; six protected old M5 slots untouched; no roadmap changes.
boundaries.task_conditions: Frozen initializer cases, target, timing, gravity, frame and acceptance; excluded from candidate design.
boundaries.unavailable: See generated catalog integration_backlog; dimension-changing edits require new engineering and shared study version.

comparison_groups.common: Identical source/cases/acceptance/pool/budgets, including allocation for complete validation. No group receives newly connected variables mid-version.
comparison_groups.feedback: Later model changes consume same cumulative ceilings; decisions retain predecessor evidence and exact state.

comparison_groups.model_validation: Revised context live input cost/response quality pending; no paid call for compression.
comparison_groups.one_shot: Freeze complete native model plan and executable branches before new outcomes. Optimizer-internal adaptation and predeclared branches allowed; no later model rewriting or branch addition.
comparison_groups.stop_assessment: Legality and factual support are recorded separately from unproven optimality.

initial_state_mapping.changes: Curvature theta/L and its rate, tip offset/velocity, mass and mechanical energy change with structure; equal tip perturbation or energy is not claimed.
initial_state_mapping.comparable: Uniform principal-axis angle/rate profile versus normalized arc; segment integrated bend and angular rate; fixed orientations, station fractions, mesh and routing.
initial_state_mapping.conservatism: 0.01 rad total bend is ~0.57 degree; each of 12 cell angles is 0.000833 rad. Velocity is nonzero, 0.001667 rad/s per cell, far below the technical maxima. Fixed before new outcomes.
initial_state_mapping.reset: Fresh backend and controller; apply both named qpos and qvel once; no relaxation, easier regeneration or repeated initialization.
initial_state_mapping.restore: Store restores sealed results and reservations, not live MuJoCo/controller state; full in-flight checkpoint resume is unsupported.
initial_state_mapping.support: initialize.family@1.0.0 + controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0 + backend.family_mujoco@1.1.0; named cell joints |q|<=.05 rad, |v|<=.5 rad/s.

metrics.actuator: Ideal nonnegative tendon tensions, same six inputs and 8 N limits; hardware actuator dynamics and force safety guarantees are outside scope.
metrics.aggregation: Acceptance count first; retain per-case/per-repetition status and component values; max position/speed and total cost separately; no arbitrary weighted score.
metrics.primary: Number of jointly accepted fresh executions / ten scheduled case-repetition executions per finalist
metrics.reference: Fixed world tip target [0.29,0.035,0.19] m; post_step position and Jacobian-derived world translational speed in final closed interval.

specification.question: Can design and control adaptation improve joint reach-and-hold robustness under predefined small initial-state variation around an already successful configuration?

repetitions.failure_rule: Every scheduled instance remains in denominator; invalid, missing, incomplete and failed results remain visible; no retries to obtain a pass.
repetitions.independence: Fresh MuJoCo model/data and controller workspace each execution. Initial profiles are deterministic; seeds label scheduled instances and do not create a stochastic population.
repetitions.inference_limit: Acceptance fraction is descriptive on this fixed five-case set, not a population success probability.
repetitions.order: case order as listed, then repetition 1 seed 17, repetition 2 seed 18
repetitions.request_identity: Unique candidate/case/repetition request in a fresh session; no automatic replay of unknown reservations.
